method: Finite points at 10/20/35/50 units from authored tent-like asset centers; source-preserved native terrain queried for slope <=15 degrees; nine terrain samples within a 2-unit clearance check reject holes and visible authored water only if its verified native level is >= the local terrain; conservative known collision AABB clearance >=2 and containing NAV_GROUND polygon plane within 2 units.
limitations: Tent interiors and connectivity between camps are unverified.
Collision clearance uses known AABBs rather than native BIH queries; rendered assets without native collision cannot supply a collision clearance proof.
Nav heights use polygon planes without Detour detail interpolation.
summary_scope: Full probe totals and source identities are retained. At most six checked ground anchors per tent are shown; the complete private probe contains every accepted anchor and every dry-terrain sample.
